<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen a claims handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their personal authority limit, the change is routed to a specific approver for sign-off. If that designated approver is unavailable (e.g., on leave) and no delegate is assigned to cover their queue, the reserve change becomes stuck. This single-point failure halts all processing on the associated claim, causing unnecessary delays, backlogs, and customer dissatisfaction while waiting for the primary approver to return.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **8 accounts** have reported this issue through account management, support, and sales channels [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- The problem is explicitly confirmed by named accounts including Pendleford Motor Mutual, Wexmoor Motor, Callowfield Auto Assurance, Ravensgill Insurance, Holloway Reach Underwriting, and Saltmarsh Specialty [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:45c3dd4ac5c4d494][i:9daa7fe509e60a2f][i:655489deaf46b80c][i:94dd9ecf8c2990c2][i:c50e7d9cace2b869].\n- Two accounts, Sallowmere Motor and Harrowfield Fleet Mutual, have also mentioned related queue or stalling issues [i:65bfde9b620967c0][i:f50f773669fba30b].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been **19 mentions** of this problem across **3 routes**: account management (6 mentions), support (7 mentions), and sales (6 mentions) [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- The collective Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from accounts is **5,420,000 GBP** [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- A customer from Pendleford Motor Mutual states, We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up... Claims are stalled [i:279cabe81068b3d3].\n- A customer from Callowfield Auto Assurance reports, the reserve authorisation delay has caused real issues for us, especially when the approver’s out and no one’s covering [i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n- A customer from Saltmarsh Specialty explains, it’s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list, and policyholders are starting to ask why payments are delayed [i:e3f90adc3c0d1c88].\n- The issue is described as blocking everything until the approver returns [i:30284f66470fac05] and causing claims to pile up [i:94dd9ecf8c2990c2]. A customer from Callowfield Auto Assurance notes it’s not sustainable [i:f6dc3676926959e6].\n- **0 renewals** have occurred in the last 90 days as of 2026-11-03 [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].\n\n## Why now\nCustomer reports cluster in September and October 2026, indicating recent, repeated operational disruptions [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3]. The issue directly impacts claim cycle times and customer service levels, with one customer noting policyholders are noticing delays [i:e3f90adc3c0d1c88]. With **0 renewals** in the past 90 days, maintaining service levels is critical [i:279cabe81068b3d3][i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3]. The problem is reported by multiple high-value accounts, including Wexmoor Motor (**1,950,000 GBP** ARR) and Callowfield Auto Assurance (**1,250,000 GBP** ARR), whose renewals are upcoming in 2027 [i:30284f66470fac05][i:47e4aac56f39b4d3].",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the figures (8 accounts, 19 mentions across 3 routes with 6/7/6 split, ARR of 5,420,000 GBP, 0 renewals, Wexmoor 1,950,000 GBP and Callowfield 1,250,000 GBP with 2027 renewals) against the fact sheet and all match. The quoted customer statements (Pendleford, Callowfield, Saltmarsh) correspond to the cited insights verbatim or near-verbatim, and each named account is backed by a cited insight; Sallowmere and Harrowfield are correctly described as only mentioning related issues, matching their vague/general quotes. No contrary evidence or overstated scope was found.", "verdict": "pass"}
